exposure: Time period of infection (pre-delta, delta, omicron)
SARS-CoV-2 infection (pre-delta, delta, and omicron variants)
cohort: 231 pregnant patients hospitalized due to severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 infection between April 2020 and April 2022.
finding: The need for oxygen support and the length of hospital stay decreased in pregnant patients infected with SARS-CoV-2 over time, likely due to changing virus variants and vaccination rates, with no significant differences in other maternal and perinatal outcomes.
